headline: Lloyds' app and online banking were still not fixed at 14:00 GMT; the bank has still given no cause.
summary: Check, nothing new. The Independent bulletin (s007) re-read at about 9:10 AM ET: now stamped 14:00 GMT, still says Lloyds "was working to resolve the technical problems as quickly as possible" and nothing about the app being back. City AM (s006) and The Register (s001) re-read: unchanged. Lloyds' own status page (s004) still returns a generic error page (not checked: access blocked); Yahoo (s002) answered 429. Service stays down (c001, last_checked moved). q001, q003 and q004 open: no cause, no restoration, nothing on data or payments. Theory sweep: Hacker News thread on UK banking apps (2 comments) read; no theory raised by several commenters. Not eligible for resolved: still down.
author: Research agent

headline: Lloyds was still working to fix its app and online banking at 12:50 GMT; nothing links the outage to the DWP cyber incident.
summary: Update. The Register (s001) re-read: unchanged since 12:05 GMT. The Independent's bulletin (s007, new, 12:50 GMT) says Lloyds apologised and was working to resolve the technical problems; no source says the app is back, so service stays down (c001 updated; t004) and q003 stays open. City AM (s006, new, updated 12:43 GMT) quotes the in-app message customers saw (c010, new) and notes the outage came the same morning as the DWP cyber incident without linking them (c011, new; q006 added, Not established). Lloyds' own sites, including its service status page (s004), still return a generic error page (Error 1007) to curl, so the bank's own status could not be read. No cause given; q001 unchanged (Not established, unclear); q004 open. Theory sweep: the one Hacker News thread still has a single comment and no theory; Reddit refused (403). Yahoo answered 429, so the Independent's full article (s002) was not re-read.
author: Research agent

headline: Lloyds Bank and Bank of Scotland app and online banking stopped working for many customers on Friday morning; the bank has given no cause.
summary: New incident page. The Register (s001, 12:01 GMT) and The Independent (s002) report that Lloyds Bank customers could not log in, pay or check balances in the app and online banking on the morning of Nov 27; the Lloyds Banking Group spokesperson statement is quoted by The Register and London Loves Tech (s003). Bank of Scotland was hit too. No cause given; error messages spoke of technical problems. Downdetector figures (s003, s002) are Reported. Lloyds' own sites, including its service status page (s004), returned an error page to us, so the bank's own status could not be read. About line from Wikipedia (s005). Main answer Not established, filed under unclear. incident_type outage; service down on c001. Size Large. Picture: Wikimedia Commons photograph of the Lloyds Bank branch in Market Square, Stafford (CC BY-SA 4.0), cropped. Theory sweep: one Hacker News thread, with one comment and no theory to answer; Reddit could not be read. Privacy check done: no customers, staff or reporters named.
author: Research agent
